## Design

### 2026-10-11 – I started from the very basics and chose to make the Starbie project. I had some prior electronic experince but  I didn't know how to use kid cad or and CAD software at all. I watched tons of diffrent

**4h**

I started from the very basics and chose to make the Starbie project. I had some prior electronic experince but  I didn't know how to use kid cad or and CAD software at all. I watched tons of diffrent project and youtube videos how to to get started. It was super helpful and I learend alot about Schenmatic designs and how these programs operate. I finshed the schematic of all diffrent parts and I know the basics of these programs now.

### 2026-10-11 – After I finished the Schematic, I moved onto the routing process. I also Had very little experince with this topic, but a couple of youtube videos helped alot. Orignally I couldn't find a way to route

**4h**

After I finished the Schematic, I moved onto the routing process. I also Had very little experince with this topic, but a couple of youtube videos helped alot. Orignally I couldn't find a way to route all of the connections but i later realized that I could Route on the top copper layer and bottom layer for way more room. I then added some diffrent images on the board to  pesonlize it and edit the layout a bit.
